Tensei Shitara Slime Datta Ken 4th Season Part 1 & 2
meta.description:
The fourth season of Tensei Shitara Slime Datta Ken.

Demon Lord Rimuru's dream of creating an alliance between humans and monsters takes a step closer to being realized. As Tempest continues to prosper, Granville Rozzo and his granddaughter, Maribel Rozzo, clash with Demon Lord Rimuru over their plan to protect mankind by ruling over them. Meanwhile, in El Dorado, Demon Lord Leon works toward goals of his own. The awakening of a new Hero draws near!

videos.title: New Days
videos.overview: Tempest is thriving after the success of its festival, but unexpected trouble has arisen with the new dungeon.

videos.title: The Dungeon Evolves
videos.overview: Rimuru and his trusted companions discuss ideas for improving the dungeon.

videos.title: The Avatar Team Is Formed
videos.overview: Rimuru, Ramiris, Veldora, and Milim work on perfecting their avatars before facing Team Green Fury.

videos.title: Invitation
videos.overview: The Council of the West deliberates on whether to grant membership to Tempest.

videos.title: The First Step
videos.overview: Rimuru attends the meeting that will determine Tempest's membership in the Council of the West.

videos.title: The Council of the West
videos.overview: A list of unreasonable demands from the Council makes Rimuru realize that a deeper plot is in motion.

videos.title: The Mastermind's Identity
videos.overview: An interrogation of Prince Elric's would-be shooter reveals who's pulling the strings behind the Council.

videos.title: The Groundwork of Greed
videos.overview: Glenda reveals all she knows about the Council and the Rozzos, and Rimuru prepares to inspect ancient ruins.

videos.title: Investigating the Ruins
videos.overview: The investigation of the ancient ruins of Amrita begins.

videos.title: The Master of Greed
videos.overview: Rimuru and Mirabel come face-to-face at last in the ancient ruins.

videos.title: Milim's Friend
videos.overview: Rimuru helps Milim confront the Chaos Dragon, a corrupted form of the baby dragon that was once her friend.

videos.title: Tempest Evolves
videos.overview: Rimuru shares his plans for Tempest's future, including a new system of government and Council representation.

videos.title: New Companions
videos.overview: Ramiris and Veldora are feeling overworked, so they ask Rimuru to find assistants for them.

videos.title: The Black Numbers
videos.overview: Diablo returns with new demon subordinates to add to Tempest's ranks.

videos.title: An Unsettling Feeling
videos.overview: As Tempest continues to grow and evolve, the Moderate Harlequin Alliance approaches Demon Lord Leon.

videos.title: Gran, the Hero of Dawn
videos.overview: Luminus meets with Rimuru to discuss Gran and future plans.

videos.title: Lubelius, the Point of Convergence
videos.overview: While Leon seeks Elmesia's help in finding Chloe, Granville's forces invade Lubelius.

videos.title: Turbulence in the West
videos.overview: An army of demons advances from the north, leaving the Western Nations in turmoil.

videos.title: Death and Loss
videos.overview: Granville's true plan is revealed, but it may already be too late to stop it.

videos.title: Chronoa the Hero (Part 1)
videos.overview: When Chloe's Time Traveler skill kicks in, Hinata's soul is sent to the past along with her.

videos.title: Chronoa the Hero (Part 2)
videos.overview: Chloe and Hinata meet Luminus and begin their journey as Chronoa.

videos.title: Where the Soul Resides
videos.overview: Chronoa is freed from her seal—not as a Hero, but as an avatar of destruction.

videos.title: Granville's Hope
videos.overview: Shion and Ranga continue to battle Razul while Rimuru struggles to save Chloe and Hinata.

videos.title: The Hero Awakens
videos.overview: Rimuru has Raphael interfere in Chronoa's Unlimited Imprisonment skill to save Hinata and Chloe.
